context.body: Paul returns to Abraham’s credited faith and describes circumcision as a sign and seal received afterward, while widening Abraham’s fatherhood beyond circumcision.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Genesis chronology becomes part of an argument about sign, promise, faith, and family.
observations.label: Circumcision as sign after faith: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps Heir of world · father of many nations visible within its covenant claim.

observations.body: Abraham · circumcised · uncircumcised · Circumcision sign/seal · Heir of world · father of many nations · Genesis sequence reread

payload.posture: Read Romans 4:9–17 as its own abraham remembered covenant setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places Heir of world · father of many nations inside this covenant setting without turning it into a definition for every covenant passage.
payload.title: Circumcision as sign after faith
